text:
joanne: Quick sync — need to lock scope for the Observability Console Q2 launch. Two customer asks are blocking: per-route cost breakdown + sample traces on error spikes. I sketched an acceptance checklist below. Can we agree on owners and what to cut if we hit time?

dave: +1. Important to be explicit about data retention and kubernetes labels for cost attribution. Who owns the dashboard wiring?

amelia: I can take dashboard wiring (backend + metrics shape). Need the JSON schema for cost tags from infra.

joanne: @amelia thanks. @dave proposal: product defines UX/filters, eng owns telemetry schema and queries. If infra can't provide labels, fallback is route-based heuristic.

sai: We should prioritize crash/error heatmap + top-10 expensive routes in first ship. Full per-token breakdown can be v2.

kevin: For tracing hooks: we need a tiny client-side wrapper (python/node) that emits span when error >= 5% or latency > p95 threshold. That avoids high cardinality. I can prototype.

zoe: From support: customers want a way to link a trace to a request id in logs. Please include request_id in trace context and in dashboard drilldown.

amelia: Noted. Plan: metrics endpoint returns {"route":..., "request_id":..., "cost_usd":...} for samples. We'll sample <= 1% traffic by default.

joanne: Draft acceptance checklist (proto):
- Dashboards: cost overview (global + per-customer), top routes, error heatmap, drilldown to traces.
- Tracing hooks: lightweight client wrappers for major SDKs + opt-in sampling rule.
- Cost breakdown: route-level USD estimate, taggable by team/customer, exportable CSV.
- Error analytics: spike detection + example traces for top errors.
- Security/compliance: redaction rules for PII in traces.
- Owners: product (joanne/sai) for UX, eng (amelia/dave) for telemetry, kevin for hooks, support (zoe) for feedback loop.

dave: Suggest adding rollout criteria: feature flag gated, behind a tenant opt-in for first 2 weeks, and automatic rollback if tracing error rate > 1% increase.

kevin: Implementation note: use async buffered emitter to avoid latency, payload schema in gist:```json
{"route":"/...","request_id":"...","latency_ms":123,"status":500,"cost_usd":0.002}
```
We should be clear about allowed cardinality for tags.

amelia: Timeline ask: backend metrics + dashboard prototype in 2 sprints, hooks in 1 sprint prototype, sampling/rollout in parallel. If we need to cut scope, drop CSV export and full per-token breakdown.

sai: Customer-facing docs: need short quickstart and an FAQ about cost accuracy. I'll draft.

joanne: Decision needed today: are we comfortable shipping with route-level USD estimates + sampled traces (<=1%) and deferring per-token billing to v2?

zoe: From customers I've spoken to — yes. They want quick visibility more than exact token accounting at first. :thumbsup:

observability-bot: Reminder: schedule kickoff meeting — /remind #product "obs console kickoff" at 2024-06-10 10:00

dave: OK let's lock it. Owners and cuts agreed: ship with route-level cost, sampled traces, rollout opt-in, CSV/per-token in v2. I'll open tech-spec PR and tag owners.

joanne: Thanks everyone — I'll update the roadmap doc and add this checklist to the launch ticket.

kevin: I'll drop the prototype link in the PR shortly.

joanne: End.
thread_summary: Scope negotiation for Observability Console: agreed ship with route-level USD estimates and sampled traces; owners assigned; CSV/per-token deferred to v2; rollout gated opt-in and rollback criteria.
